notifications.title: SpotNav · {name}
notifications.stopped.not_started: Charging did not start as planned.
notifications.stopped.stopped: Charging stopped during a planned window.
notifications.stopped.charger_unavailable: The charger is unavailable during a planned window.
notifications.stopped.vehicle_not_requesting: The car is not taking current during a planned window.
notifications.stopped.held_by_charger: The charger's own schedule is holding back the planned charge.
notifications.stopped.charger_ignores_stop: The charger keeps charging although it was stopped. Stop it at the charger or unplug the car.
notifications.stopped.charger_disabled: The charger is disabled, so the planned charge cannot start.
notifications.at_risk: The charge will not be ready by the departure.
notifications.at_risk.time: The charge will not be ready by the departure at {time}.
notifications.complete.target: Charging complete: the target {percent} was reached.
notifications.complete.energy: Charging complete: the requested energy was delivered.
notifications.complete.vehicle_full: Charging complete: the car is full.
notifications.test: Test notification from SpotNav: notifications reach this phone.

add_charger.hint: Add a charger: Settings → Devices & services → SpotNav → Add entry → Charger; it will offer to join this site.

resolve_vehicle.dismiss: This is not a vehicle (stop reporting it)

charger_detected.external: Another controller (evcc or openWB) is installed and may already control this charger. Nothing is suggested: choose only what you are sure SpotNav should drive.
charger_detected.external_installed: evcc or openWB is installed in Home Assistant and may already control this charger. Turn it off for this charger, or SpotNav and it will fight.
charger_detected.disabled: Disabled by default, and useful (they are enabled if you leave the box below ticked):
charger_detected.balanced: Perific balances this charger's installation through Zaptec's cloud and sets the same available current SpotNav would. No current is suggested: SpotNav only starts and stops the charger.
charger_detected.controller: {name} also controls chargers; turn it off for this charger or SpotNav and {name} will fight.
charger_detected.cloud: If the charger is linked to Tibber (or another app) for smart charging, turn that off: Home Assistant cannot see it, and it will fight SpotNav.

measurement_reason.mode: The measurement mode changed, so the measurement needs to be set up.
measurement_reason.chargers: The chargers changed, so their phase wiring needs to be set up.
measurement_reason.measurement: The stored measurement is incomplete, so it needs to be set up.

site_confirm.current_entity: one entity with the current per phase
site_confirm.join_unknown: SpotNav cannot tell how this charger is wired, so it is not added automatically. Add it from the site's settings.
site_confirm.reactive_missing: **Reactive power:** not found (current estimated with power factor 0.9)
site_confirm.ocpp_current_number: **Current set via:** the charger's current number ({name})

candidate_reason.attributes_device_class_and_unit_match: current device class and a supported unit
candidate_reason.attributes_historical_match: per-phase data seen in history, not measured right now
candidate_reason.attributes_profile_match: the charger integration's own per-phase current attributes
candidate_reason.separate_entities_device_class_and_unit_: current device class and a supported unit
candidate_reason.separate_entities_profile_match: the charger integration's own per-phase current sensors
candidate_reason.possible_inverter_output_not_confirmed_a: looks like inverter/solar output, not confirmed as grid input

choice.manual_separate_entities: Choose manually (three separate entities, one per phase)
choice.manual_attributes: Enter one entity + its phase attributes manually

current_control.number: The charger's current number, within its write limits
